name: Zoho Flow
description: Zoho Flow connects applications through trigger-and-action workflows, with a visual builder, conditional logic, and paid-plan custom functions. Capacity depends on executed tasks, not just the number of workflows.
best_for: Operations teams that need application-to-application automation and can validate connector coverage, task volume, polling delay, and failure handling before switching.
features: Webhook and polling triggers, depending on the connector
Premium connectors, on-premises integration and automatic reruns on Professional

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: 100 tasks/month and up to 5 flows; 30-day history and 15-minute polling. A task is a successful action execution, not a complete workflow run.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.notes: For 5,000 tasks/month: $25/month on annual billing ($300/year), or $29/month billed monthly. Unlimited flows, 60-day history, 15-minute polling and custom functions. Larger task tiers cost more; local taxes are extra.

tiers.name: Professional
tiers.notes: For 10,000 tasks/month: $41/month on annual billing ($492/year), or $49/month billed monthly. Adds premium apps, on-premises integration, automatic reruns, 5-minute polling and 90-day history. Larger task tiers cost more; local taxes are extra.

alternatives.name: Zapier
alternatives.description: A no-code automation platform that connects thousands of web apps through simple trigger-and-action workflows.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want fast, no-code automations between cloud apps

alternatives.name: Make
alternatives.description: A visual automation platform for building multi-step workflows between apps with a drag-and-drop scenario builder.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want visual, complex multi-step automations

alternatives.name: Pipedream
alternatives.description: A developer-focused integration and automation platform for building workflows that connect APIs, AI, and databases with code-level control when needed.
alternatives.best_for: Developers who want visual workflows with optional custom code

pros: A free edition can evaluate a small workflow without a paid subscription.
Paid plans allow unlimited flows within the selected task allowance.
Usage and overage controls make the task budget inspectable inside the account.
cons: A multi-action workflow consumes multiple tasks; workflow-run counts alone understate usage.
Premium connectors and automatic reruns require Professional; buying extra Standard tasks does not add those features.
Flows can stop at the task limit when overage is disabled; enabled overage adds charges and needs a daily limit.
